title: Unbounded strong-product ratios for the Grundy domination number
description: Explicit finite graphs have unbounded ratios of their strong-product Grundy domination number to the product of the factor Grundy domination numbers. Two finite-field incidence matrices give a complete elementary proof. A separate half-graph proof determines gamma_gr(H_N)=floor((N+1)/3)+3 for all N>=6 and gives a 114-vertex counterexample with the octahedron. The Lean certificate covers only the original N=21 example. This is a manuscript prepared for submission; no journal acceptance is claimed. AI assistance and affected proof locations are disclosed in the manuscript.
